library(dplyr)

## Load meta data

```{r Load meta data}
meta = as_tibble(data.table::fread('sample_file.csv'))

meta$true_file_name = sapply(strsplit(meta$file_name, '_'), function(x) paste(x[5:length(x)], collapse = '_'))

meta$analysis_id = sapply(strsplit(meta$true_file_name, '\\.'), function(x) x[1])
```

```{r Check meta data}
# Patients
patients = sort(unique(sapply(strsplit(meta$sample_alias, '_'), head, n = 1)))

head(patients)

tail(patients)

length(patients)


# Data collection type
collection_types = sapply(strsplit(meta$sample_alias, '_'), function(x) x[2])

table(collection_types)
```

```{r}
# Tumor symbols
tumor_symbols = sapply(strsplit(meta$sample_alias, '_|-'), function(x) x[3])

table(tumor_symbols)
# T: tumor
# LN: lymph node
# N: normal sample

xtabs(~ collection_types + tumor_symbols)
```

```{r}
# Exclude normal samples & lymph nodes
meta = meta[tumor_symbols %in% c('T1', 'T2'), ]

tumor_symbols = sapply(strsplit(meta$sample_alias, '_|-'), function(x) x[3])
```

```{r}
# Try to match tumors between somatic mutation data & RNA-seq data

# For somatic mutation data
mut_df = readRDS('../somatic_mutation/mut_df.rds')

mut_samples_with_multiple_tumors = sort(unique(grep('_', mut_df$tumour_id, value = T)))

mut_samples_with_multiple_tumors

# For RNA-seq data
rnaseq_samples_with_T2 = sort(unique(meta$sample_alias[tumor_symbols == 'T2']))

rnaseq_samples_with_T2

# It seems they collected new tumors after DNA-seq
```

```{r}
# Can't match at tumor level. Aggregate mutations & TCRs to patient level
meta$tumor = sapply(strsplit(meta$sample_alias, '_'), head, n = 1) 

# Number of tumors (i.e. patients)
length(unique(meta$tumor))
```

```{r}
# Region symbols
region_symbols = sapply(strsplit(meta$sample_alias, '-'), function(x) x[2])

table(region_symbols)
```

## Load TRUST4 results

```{r Load TRUST4 results}
get_trust4_results <- function(file) {
  raw = readr::read_tsv(file, num_threads = 1)
  
  chain = substr(raw$V, 1, 3)
  raw = raw[chain %in% c('TRA', 'TRB'), ]
  
  data = tibble(cdr3_aa = raw$CDR3aa, cdr3_nt = raw$CDR3nt, chain = substr(raw$V, 3, 3), count = raw$`#count`, 
                V = raw$V, D = raw$D, J = raw$J, C = raw$C)
  
  return(data)
}

# Load 
tumors = sort(unique(meta$tumor))

tcr = Reduce(rbind, parallel::mcmapply(function(tumor) {
  folders = meta$analysis_id[meta$tumor == tumor]
  
  new = Reduce(rbind, lapply(folders, function(folder) 
    bind_cols(analysis_id = folder, get_trust4_results(paste0('trust4_results/', folder, '/res_report.tsv')))))
  
  new = bind_cols(tumor = tumor, new)
  
  return(new)
}, tumors, SIMPLIFY = F, mc.cores = 36))
```

## QC

```{r}
## AA sequences
table(unlist(strsplit(tcr$cdr3_aa, '')))

# Remove those with ? & out_of_frame
tcr = tcr %>% filter(cdr3_aa != 'out_of_frame', !grepl('\\?|_', cdr3_aa))

table(unlist(strsplit(tcr$cdr3_aa, '')))
```

## Number of TCRs a tumor has

```{r}
ntcr = tcr %>% group_by(tumor, chain) %>% summarise(ntcr = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')

ggplot(ntcr, aes(ntcr, fill = chain)) +
  geom_histogram(position = position_stack()) +
  labs(color = '', x = 'Number of TCRs a tumor has', fill = '') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(breaks = c('A', 'B'), labels = c('alpha chain', 'beta chain')) +
  theme_pubr()

# Top tumors
ntcr %>% filter(ntcr > 3000)
```

## Number of unique TCRs a tumor has

```{r}
n_unique_tcr = tcr %>% group_by(tumor, chain) %>% summarise(ntcr = length(unique(cdr3_aa)), .groups = 'drop')

ggplot(n_unique_tcr, aes(ntcr, fill = chain)) +
  geom_histogram(position = position_stack()) +
  labs(color = '', x = 'Number of unique TCRs a tumor has') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(breaks = c('A', 'B'), labels = c('alpha chain', 'beta chain')) +
  theme_pubr()

# Top tumors
n_unique_tcr %>% filter(ntcr > 500)
```

## Total counts of a TCR

```{r}
tcr_freq = tcr %>% group_by(cdr3_aa, chain) %>% summarise(freq = sum(count), .groups = 'drop')

ggplot(tcr_freq, aes(freq, fill = chain)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = log10(after_stat(count) + 1)), position = position_stack()) +
  labs(color = '', x = 'Total counts of a TCR', y = 'log10(count + 1)') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(breaks = c('A', 'B'), labels = c('alpha chain', 'beta chain')) +
  theme_pubr()

# Top TCRs
tcr_freq %>% filter(freq > 900)
```

## Number of tumors where a TCR appears

```{r}
ntumor_per_tcr = tcr %>% group_by(cdr3_aa, chain) %>% summarise(ntumor = length(unique(tumor)), .groups = 'drop')

ggplot(ntumor_per_tcr, aes(ntumor, fill = chain)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = log10(after_stat(count) + 1)), position = position_stack()) +
  labs(color = '', x = 'Number of tumors where a TCR appears', y = 'log10(count + 1)') +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(breaks = c('A', 'B'), labels = c('alpha chain', 'beta chain')) +
  theme_pubr()

# Top TCRs
ntumor_per_tcr %>% filter(ntumor > 20)
```

## Build TCR matrix

```{r TCRs}
# Distinguish same AA sequences from different chains
tcr$tcr_id = paste0(tcr$cdr3_aa, '_', tcr$chain)

tcrs = sort(unique(tcr$tcr_id))

head(tcrs)

tail(tcrs)

length(tcrs)
```

```{r Build TCR matrix}
mat = matrix(NA, nrow = length(tumors), ncol = length(tcrs), dimnames = list(tumors, tcrs))

for (tumor in tumors) {
  curr = tcr[tcr$tumor == tumor, ]
  
  mat[tumor, ] = parallel::mcmapply(function(id) {
    if (!(id %in% curr$tcr_id)) return(0)
    curr %>% filter(tcr_id == id) %>% pull(count) %>% sum()
  }, tcrs, SIMPLIFY = T, mc.cores = 36)
}
```

## Save

```{r Save}
saveRDS(meta, file = 'results/meta.rds')
saveRDS(tcr, file = 'results/tcr_df.rds')
saveRDS(mat, file = 'results/tcr_mat.rds')
```
